notice: 未标注价格商品紧急筹备中，暂时不可下单。无需网站付款，下单后联系店主。
Unpriced products are being prepared and cannot be ordered yet. No payment is required on the website; contact the host after placing your order.
variantPriceHelp: 留空沿用商品售价；填写后，该规格按独立售价计算，不参与多件优惠。
Leave blank to use the product price. A variant with its own price is excluded from multi-buy offers.
variantOfferNote: 独立定价的规格不参与多件优惠。
Variants with their own prices are excluded from multi-buy offers.
optionsHelp: 顾客下单时需选择一个规格；没有规格的商品可直接加入购物车。
Customers select a variant before adding the product to their cart. Leave this empty for products without variants.
offerHelp: 同一商品的不同规格可以凑单。按优惠组数计算，余下件数按单价计算。
Mix variants of the same product. Complete bundles receive the offer price; remaining items use the regular price.
invalidOffer: 优惠总价应低于按单价购买相同件数的总价。
The bundle price must be lower than buying the same quantity individually.
serviceContact: Contact the host for a quote
name: 怎么称呼您（可选）
Your name (optional)
notes: 订单备注 / 定制要求（可选）
success: 您已成功下单，请联系店主安排付款与发货，谢谢合作！
Your order has been placed. Please contact the host to arrange payment and delivery. Thank you!
leaveContact: 或留下您的联系方式，店主会第一时间联系您。
Or leave your contact details and the host will get in touch as soon as possible.
ordersHelp: 查看商品规格、优惠和联系方式，联系顾客安排付款与发货。
Review variants, offers and contact details, then arrange payment and delivery with the customer.
searchOrders: 搜索订单、姓名或联系方式
Search orders, names or contact details
completeHelp: 完成订单会扣除库存；取消订单会释放预留库存。已完成或已取消的订单不能再更改状态。
Completing an order deducts stock; cancelling releases reserved stock. Completed or cancelled orders cannot change status.
ineligible: 购物车含未定价、下架、缺货或需联系报价的商品。请先移除这些商品。
Your cart includes unpriced, unavailable, out-of-stock or quote-only items. Remove them to continue.
missingVariant: 请为购物车中的商品选择有效规格。
Please select a valid variant for each cart item.
uncertain: 暂未收到提交结果。请点击“重试提交”，系统会核对同一笔订单。
The submission result has not arrived. Retry to check the same order without creating a duplicate.
shop_choose_variant: 商品规格已更新，请重新选择。
Product variants have changed. Please choose again.
shop_unpriced_or_hidden: 商品未定价、已下架或需要联系报价，请重新确认购物车。
An item is unpriced, unavailable or requires a quote. Please review your cart.
shop_manual_closed: 小店暂未开放下单，请稍后再试。
Ordering is currently closed. Please try again later.
shop_order_finished: 订单已完成或已取消，不能再更改状态。
This order is completed or cancelled and its status cannot be changed.
stock_unavailable: 所选数量超过可用库存，请减少数量后重试。
The selected quantity exceeds available stock. Reduce it and try again.
version_conflict: 记录已更新，请刷新后再保存。
This record has changed. Refresh it before saving.
price_changed: 商品或价格已更新，请重新确认后提交。
Products or prices have changed. Review them before placing your order.
